name: The Northernmost Padang Besar 22KM & 12KM 2026
short_description: A half-marathon and 12KM race held in Padang Besar, Perlis, Malaysia on 8 August 2026, with registration currently closed.
ai_summary: The Northernmost Padang Besar 22KM & 12KM 2026 is a half-marathon-distance race set to take place on 8 August 2026 in Padang Besar, Perlis, Malaysia. The event offers two distance options, 21.1KM and 12KM, giving participants a choice based on their fitness level. Registration for this race is currently closed, so new sign-ups are not being accepted at this time.
pros: Takes place in Padang Besar, Perlis, a notable location in Malaysia's northernmost region
cons: Registration is currently closed, so new entrants cannot sign up
research_highlights: This is a night run edition: the event description states it is <cite index="35-1,35-2,35-3">a special program with a night run concept organized by PUTRA Trail Running Club, passing through Chuping Valley, ICQS Complex, Arked Niaga, Dataran Padang Besar, Felda Rimba Mas and Kampung Kok Mak, starting as early as 1:30 am to 6:00 am</cite>.
The event is co-organized by Putra Trail Running Club and the Perlis State Government, per the official registration listing.
Padang Besar is Malaysia's northernmost major town, a border crossing with Thailand's Songkhla province, known for its duty-free shopping complex.
The organizer notes that flag-off and cut-off times may be adjusted depending on conditions, and recommends runners carry a running/RFID chip (RC recommended).

faqs.question: When is the Northernmost Padang Besar 22KM & 12KM 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The race is scheduled to take place on 8 August 2026. It is held in Padang Besar, Perlis, Malaysia, and offers runners a choice between a 21.1KM half-marathon distance and a shorter 12KM distance option on the same day.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Participants can choose between two distances: a 21.1KM half-marathon and a 12KM race. This gives runners of different experience levels and fitness goals the flexibility to select the option that best suits their training and racing ambitions.

faqs.question: Can I still register for this race?
faqs.answer: No, registration for the Northernmost Padang Besar 22KM & 12KM 2026 is currently listed as closed. Prospective participants are unable to sign up for either the 21.1KM or 12KM distance at this time based on the available information.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place in Padang Besar, located in the state of Perlis, Malaysia. This location is highlighted as the northernmost point associated with the event, making it a distinctive setting for both the 21.1KM and 12KM race distances.
